_comment: The one registry of elections in this corpus: id -> official Lithuanian
name, a short label for chart axes, and the first-round date.
Before this file there were three hand-maintained lists -- ELECTION_ORDER
in scripts/build_person_index.py plus ELECTION_LABELS and SHORT_LABELS in
dashboard/index.html -- and adding an election meant editing all three.
The last additions edited none of them, so 2011-vasario-27-savivaldybiu
(16,400 records) was invisible to the dashboard and six more elections
rendered as raw slugs. See GitHub issue #63.
`date` is the first round; its job is chronological ordering, which is why
entries are stored sorted by it. Dates and scopes come from the election
table in docs/CLI_REFERENCE.md. Adding an election means adding one entry
here -- tests/test_elections_registry.py fails if data/<id>/ exists
